# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use **Report a vulnerability** on the repository's [Security page](https://github.com/SchemaFoxLabs/NetherMC/security) when that option is available. Do not disclose vulnerability details in a public Issue.

If the private reporting option is unavailable, open a public Issue asking only for an appropriate private contact method. Include no exploit details, credentials, private account information, or other sensitive material.

Use the [Bug report form](https://github.com/SchemaFoxLabs/NetherMC/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) for ordinary functional failures that do not expose a security weakness or create a risk of abuse.

Include the affected feature, observed behavior, and enough detail to assess the security impact.

## Rule wording and translation feedback

NetherMC also accepts discrepancies or ambiguity in its server and community rules through this private route, including issues in the English version. Identify the document, language, and passage, and explain the ambiguity or suggested correction.
